title: B5
query: Find all the proteins that are associated with the same pathways and conduct the same ions as the protein 'KCNG3'.

ablation_results.with_instructions: MATCH (p:Protein {label: 'KCNG3'}) OPTIONAL MATCH (p)-[:hasPathway]->(path:Pathway) WITH p, collect(DISTINCT path) AS pathways OPTIONAL MATCH (p)-[:hasIonAsso]->(ion:Ion) WITH pathways, collect(DISTINCT ion) AS ions MATCH (other:Protein)-[:hasPathway]->(path:Pathway)   WHERE path IN pathways MATCH (other)-[:hasIonAsso]->(ion:Ion)   WHERE ion IN ions AND other.label <> 'KCNG3' RETURN DISTINCT other.label AS Protein LIMIT 100
ablation_results.without_instructions: MATCH (target:Protein {label: 'KCNG3'}) MATCH (target)-[:hasPathway]->(p:Pathway)<-[:hasPathway]-(similar:Protein) MATCH (target)-[:hasIonAsso]->(i:Ion)<-[:hasIonAsso]-(similar) WHERE similar <> target RETURN DISTINCT similar
ablation_results.without_schema_comments: MATCH (k {label: 'KCNG3'}) MATCH (k)-[:hasPathway]->(pathway) MATCH (k)-[:hasIonAsso]->(ion) MATCH (p)-[:hasPathway]->(pathway) MATCH (p)-[:hasIonAsso]->(ion) WHERE p <> k RETURN DISTINCT p.label AS protein LIMIT 100
ablation_results.without_relevant_nodes: MATCH (p) WHERE p.label = 'KCNG3' AND (p:Protein OR p:LightKinase OR p:DarkKinase OR p:LightIonChannel OR p:DarkIonChannel) WITH p MATCH (p)-[:hasPathway]->(pw:Pathway) WITH p, collect(DISTINCT pw) AS pathways MATCH (p)-[:hasIonAsso]->(ion:Ion) WITH p, pathways, collect(DISTINCT ion) AS ions MATCH (other) WHERE (other:Protein OR other:LightKinase OR other:DarkKinase OR other:LightIonChannel OR other:DarkIonChannel) AND other <> p MATCH (other)-[:hasPathway]->(pw2:Pathway) WHERE pw2 IN pathways MATCH (other)-[:hasIonAsso]->(ion2:Ion) WHERE ion2 IN ions RETURN DISTINCT other.label LIMIT 100

ablation_results.without_relevant_nodes: MATCH (n {label: 'HTR3E'}) WHERE n:LightIonChannel OR n:DarkIonChannel OR n:Protein MATCH (n)-[:hasFamily]->(f:Family) MATCH (n)-[:hasGroup]->(g:Group) RETURN DISTINCT f.label AS Family, g.label AS Group LIMIT 100

title: C2
query: Find all ion channels that are connected to the 'Neuronal System' pathway through interacting proteins.

ablation_results.with_instructions: MATCH (p:Pathway {label: 'Neuronal System'})<-[:hasPathway]-(protein)-[:interact]-(ic) WHERE ic:LightIonChannel OR ic:DarkIonChannel RETURN DISTINCT ic.label AS ionChannelLabel LIMIT 100
ablation_results.without_instructions: MATCH (ic) WHERE ic:LightIonChannel OR ic:DarkIonChannel MATCH (ic)-[:interact]-(interactor) WHERE interactor <> ic MATCH (interactor)-[:hasPathway]->(pw:Pathway {label: "Neuronal System"}) RETURN DISTINCT ic.id AS id, ic.label AS name
ablation_results.without_schema_comments: MATCH (ic)-[:interact]-(p:Protein)-[:hasPathway]->(pw:Pathway) WHERE pw.label = 'Neuronal System' AND (ic:LightIonChannel OR ic:DarkIonChannel) RETURN DISTINCT ic.label LIMIT 100
ablation_results.without_relevant_nodes: MATCH (ic)-[:interact]-(p)-[:hasPathway]->(path:Pathway {label: 'Neuronal System'}) WHERE ic:LightIonChannel OR ic:DarkIonChannel RETURN DISTINCT ic.label AS ionChannel LIMIT 100

title: C3
query: List the light ion channels in the Chloride channels group and their respective functional domains.

ablation_results.with_instructions: MATCH (lic:LightIonChannel)-[:hasGroup]->(g:Group) WHERE g.label = 'Chloride channels' MATCH (lic)-[:hasFunctionalDomain]->(fd:FunctionalDomain) RETURN DISTINCT lic.label AS light_ion_channel, fd.label AS functional_domain LIMIT 100
ablation_results.without_instructions: MATCH (l:LightIonChannel)-[:hasGroup]->(g:Group {label: "Chloride channels"}) OPTIONAL MATCH (l)-[:hasFunctionalDomain]->(fd:FunctionalDomain) RETURN l.label AS LightIonChannel, COLLECT(DISTINCT fd.label) AS FunctionalDomains
ablation_results.without_schema_comments: MATCH (c:LightIonChannel)-[:hasGroup]->(g:Group {label: 'Chloride channels'}) MATCH (c)-[:hasFunctionalDomain]->(fd:FunctionalDomain) RETURN DISTINCT c.label AS LightIonChannel, fd.label AS FunctionalDomain LIMIT 100
ablation_results.without_relevant_nodes: MATCH (c:LightIonChannel)-[:hasGroup]->(g:Group {label: 'Chloride channels'}) MATCH (c)-[:hasFunctionalDomain]->(d:FunctionalDomain) RETURN DISTINCT c.label AS lightIonChannel, d.label AS functionalDomain LIMIT 100

title: C4
query: Which ions are connected to the chemical 'Ozone' through biological processes that involve proteins?

ablation_results.with_instructions: MATCH (c:Chemical {label: 'Ozone'}) MATCH (c)-[:assoWithBiologicalProcess]->(bp:BiologicalProcess) MATCH (p)-[:hasBiologicalProcess]->(bp) MATCH (p)-[:hasIonAsso]->(i:Ion) RETURN DISTINCT i.label AS Ion LIMIT 100
ablation_results.without_instructions: MATCH (c:Chemical {label: 'Ozone'})-[:assoWithBiologicalProcess]->(bp:BiologicalProcess)<-[:hasBiologicalProcess]-(p)-[:hasIonAsso]->(i:Ion) WHERE (p:Protein OR p:LightKinase OR p:DarkKinase OR p:LightIonChannel OR p:DarkIonChannel) RETURN DISTINCT i
ablation_results.without_schema_comments: MATCH (c:Chemical {name: 'Ozone'})-[r:assoWithBiologicalProcess]->(bp:BiologicalProcess)<-[:hasBiologicalProcess]-(p)-[:hasIonAsso]->(i:Ion) RETURN DISTINCT i.label AS ion_label LIMIT 100
ablation_results.without_relevant_nodes: MATCH (oz:Chemical {label:'Ozone'})-[:assoWithGene]->(p1:Protein|LightKinase|DarkKinase|LightIonChannel|DarkIonChannel)-[:hasBiologicalProcess]->(bp:BiologicalProcess) MATCH (p2:Protein|LightIonChannel|DarkIonChannel)-[:hasBiologicalProcess]->(bp) MATCH (p2)-[:hasIonAsso]->(i:Ion) RETURN DISTINCT i.label UNION MATCH (oz:Chemical {label:'Ozone'})-[:assoWithBiologicalProcess]->(bp:BiologicalProcess) MATCH (p:Protein|LightIonChannel|DarkIonChannel)-[:hasBiologicalProcess]->(bp) MATCH (p)-[:hasIonAsso]->(i:Ion) RETURN DISTINCT i.label LIMIT 100
